name: print-social-blue-and-green-hiring-graphic-designer-cover-with-megaphones
title: 'We Are HIRING! GRAPHIC Designer' cover with blue and green type, two megaphones and a two-column role panel
whatItIs: A wide light-grey Facebook cover with a blurred office, a headline with navy 'HIRING!' and green 'GRAPHIC', two black-and-blue megaphones, and a deep blue rounded panel with a green 'Open Positions' speech tab over a two-column grid of white role pills, plus CV email, WhatsApp and address.
whatItMeans: Busy but organised; the two-column grid fits many roles in a banner.
techniques: Arrange many roles in a two-column pill grid.
Use a speech-tab label on the panel.
Pair two accent colours in the headline.

vocabulary.definition: A label with a small pointer like a speech bubble.
